{{Short description | Administrative divisions in Turkey}}
[[Image:NUTS Map of Turkey.png | thumb | NUTS of Turkey on first level]]
[[File:Turkey NUTS 2nd Level.png | thumb | NUTS of Turkey on second level]]
As a [[Future enlargement of the European Union#Recognised candidates | candidate country]] of the [[European Union]], [[Turkey]] (TR) is included in the [[Nomenclature of Territorial Units for Statistics]] (NUTS). Defined in 2002 in agreement between [[Eurostat]] and the Turkish authorities, Turkey's NUTS classifications are officially termed ''statistical regions'', as Turkey is not a member of the EU and Eurostat only defines NUTS for member states.<ref>{{Cite web | url=http://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/web/nuts/statistical-regions-outside-eu | title=Statistical Regions outside the EU | website=Eurostat | access-date=3 Jul 2016}}</ref> The three NUTS levels are:
* NUTS-1: 12 [[First-level NUTS of the European Union | Regions]]
* NUTS-2: 26 [[Nomenclature_of_Territorial_Units_for_Statistics#Levels | Subregions]]
* NUTS-3: 81 [[Provinces of Turkey | Provinces]]

Below the NUTS levels, there are two [[local administrative unit | LAU]] levels:
* LAU-1: 923 [[Districts of Turkey | districts]]
* LAU-2: 37,675 [[List of municipalities in Turkey | municipalities]]<ref>{{Cite web | url=http://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/web/nuts/correspondence-tables/national-structures-non-eu | title=National Structures (Non-EU) | website=Eurostat | access-date=3 Jul 2016}}</ref>

The NUTS codes are as follows:
